name: Trinath Singh/ ତ୍ରିନାଥ ସିଂ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Trinath Singh writes poetry in Odia. His collections include “Kolahala”, recorded in Odisha’s library-selection catalogue as a 2009 poetry publication from Samanwaya. The journal’s contributor note also lists “Feranta Pakshi” and “Chupchap Chaturthadhadire”. His poem here brings the smallest visible sign of feeling into contact with a much larger human world.

“Luhabunde” begins with a tear that trembles but cannot fall. Its questions travel through stars and mountains, a soldier’s remaining blood, inherited burdens, waiting elders and a woman unable to return home. The tear becomes a gathering place for grief that cannot find expression. By the end, its concentrated heat suggests the possibility that feeling might become a force capable of reaching beyond one person.
